quantity: volume-equivalent diameter of the archived ADAM model
reference: DAMIT model 1798 calibrated size, Hanuš et al. (2017), A&A 601, A114
notes: DAMIT marks model 1798 as size-calibrated (D = 133 km, σ = 4 km), the volume-equivalent diameter of this ADAM solution. Hanuš et al. (2017) Table 4 lists 132 ± 4 km for the publication fit; the archived release is kept as archived. The fit used 13 light curves, 1 adaptive-optics image and 2 occultations (Table 3).
